steps.what: Submit requests from engineers and technicians

loop.output: a reading that quotes the system id and the asked change
loop.check: The system id on the reading exists on the request or the reading is blank
loop.stop: One pass, then leave the reading blank if no system id is present
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason is free text and a form rule cannot classify every row

steps.what: Read the decision on the request

tasks.design: Engineers, managers and technicians send a modification request on a {WORKFLOW} form with system id, change, reason and requester. The specialist reviews it against the current standard in {DOCS}. Accept, defer or refuse stays a decision. Only the signed decision may be used for a later change. This task does not make the change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests arrived as mail with no system id, so two people could approve different versions of the same idea.
tasks.enabler_now: A request can carry a system id and a requester, and the current standard can be opened on that id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the modification is worth doing, and who is disrupted, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist accepts, defers or refuses, and says why.

ambition.what: Decide modification requests in the week they arrive, not in a monthly meeting

tasks.altitude: Less time reconstructing the thread. The specialist can refuse a request that has no system id, and still owns the yes or no.

reach.task: Design only the modifications the specialist accepted
reach.learn: Which request was accepted, deferred or refused, and on what date

evidence.claim: Reviewing modification requests is mailbox and document work plus a decision. The decision does not get easier because the request is on a form.
A request without a system id cannot be matched to a standard by a fixed rule. Someone still reads the reason.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task ends when a signed decision is filed. Implementing the modification is a later task.

Input contract: request id, system id, change text, reason, requester role, date. Producer is the network architect collecting requests from engineers, managers and technicians. A request with no system id is returned, not decided.
Use the workflow form before custom code. Many requests are mailbox work. A meeting is only for the ones the specialist cannot decide from the record.
unknowns: Which requester roles may submit a modification.
Whether a refused request can be appealed, and to whom.
research_questions: What share of requests arrives with no system id?
How often is an accepted request later reversed?

already_counted.description: Specialist finishes readings the draft left blank
The accept or refuse stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Keep the decision reasons aligned when a new change type appears
Requesters resubmit requests the form returns for a missing system id

approvals.approved_version: modification decision signed for this request id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most requests stay as free-text mail, so the specialist still reconstructs them. The high case assumes clean requests but every accept, defer or refuse stays manual. Implementing the change is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Run backups and perform preventive maintenance

steps.what: Perform preventive maintenance on the equipment
Perform recovery when the procedure says so
Close failed backup or skipped jobs

tasks.design: A procedure in {DOCS} names the equipment id, the window and whether the action is backup, preventive maintenance or recovery. The specialist signs that procedure version for the window. Named backups then run on {OPS_SYSTEM}. Maintenance and recovery stay in person on the equipment and are never unattended. Failed jobs stay on a {BI} list. The log stores the job result and the equipment id, not message contents.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures were documents, and success was checked by eye, so a job could not know which procedure version was current.
tasks.enabler_now: Backup jobs can already run on a schedule. The missing piece is a signed procedure version and an equipment id.
tasks.still_hard: Preventive maintenance and a live recovery still depend on the specialist being with the equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist signs the procedure for this window and stops a job or a recovery that looks wrong.

ambition.what: Confirm a failed backup the same day, instead of at the next monthly visit

tasks.altitude: Scheduled backups leave the week when the procedure is signed. Maintenance, recovery and failed jobs stay with the specialist, who can refuse an unattended run.

reach.task: See which equipment missed its backup window
reach.learn: Which procedure version is current and which jobs failed

evidence.claim: Preventive maintenance and recovery on telecommunications equipment are hands-on. A named backup is the part that can run from a signed procedure.
Digest [S22] says security logging must stay necessary and proportionate. A backup log should record the job result and the equipment id, not message contents.
Digest [S28] reports a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so an unattended recovery or other live change is out of scope.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task covers performing the procedure, not writing the disaster recovery plan.

Input contract: equipment id, procedure id, action (backup, maintenance or recovery), window start, window end. Producer is the signed procedure. A job with no equipment id does not run and stays on the manual list.

Use the operations system's own job schedule before custom code. The in-person prior is accepted for maintenance and recovery. The log is not used to watch staff, so this design does not ask the works council for monitoring consent.
unknowns: Which equipment has no job interface and must stay manual.
Who may sign a procedure window when the specialist is away.
research_questions: What share of backup jobs failed last month?
How many recoveries were started outside the signed procedure?

already_counted.description: Procedure sign-off for the window stays with the specialist
On-site maintenance stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Revise procedure fields when a new equipment type is added

approvals.approved_version: procedure version signed for this window
recovery decision for this equipment id and window

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes much of the equipment has no job interface, so backups stay manual and only the procedure record is new. The high case assumes named backups run, while every maintenance visit, every recovery and every failed job still takes specialist time. No unattended live change.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect device locations and conduit pathways

steps.what: Open the site list for the visit
Inspect sites to determine device locations
Record conduit pathways and physical configuration

tasks.design: The specialist walks the site and records device locations and conduit pathways. A {WORKFLOW} form captures site id, device id, location and pathway, and the record is filed in {DOCS}. The walk stays in person. Nothing about the physical configuration is inferred from the old drawing alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locations lived in notebooks and old drawings, so the next person could not tell which pathway had actually been seen.
tasks.enabler_now: A form can require a site id and a device id before a location is stored.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the conduit and the device still means being in the building.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides what was actually seen and what is only a guess from an old drawing.
tasks.altitude: Writing up the visit takes less reconstruction. The specialist still walks the site and can refuse to file a location they did not see.

reach.task: Use the filed configuration instead of an old drawing
reach.learn: Which device locations were seen on which date, and which pathways are blank

evidence.claim: Inspecting device locations and conduit pathways is in-person work. The record of what was seen can be a form. The visit cannot.
A mid-size firm rarely has a complete conduit record. People trust the last person who walked the floor, which is why the record needs a date and a name.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task ends when the site configuration record is filed. Changing the pathway is a later task.
Input contract: site id, device id, location text, pathway text, visit date. Producer is the specialist from the walk. A row with no device id is not filed as a location.
Use the workflow form before custom code. The in-person prior is accepted: about the whole task is the walk, not a screen.
unknowns: Which sites require an escort or a permit.
Whether photographs of pathways are allowed in the building.
research_questions: What share of device locations on file has no visit date?
How often does a walk contradict the stored drawing?

already_counted.description: The site walk stays with the specialist
Writing what was seen stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Adjust the location form when a new pathway type appears

approvals.approved_version: site configuration signed for this visit date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the walk is unchanged and only a few sites use the form. The high case assumes the write-up is shorter but every inspection stays in person. The walk itself is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain vendor pricing and technical specifications

steps.what: List available hardware, software and services

loop.input: vendor reply and the question list
loop.output: price rows with a component id and a number
loop.check: Each kept row has a component id from the question list and a numeric price
loop.stop: One pass, then leave unmatched lines on a manual list
loop.why_not_simpler: Vendor prose mixes the price with conditions a column map misses

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} request lists the hardware, software or service, the site and the questions. The specialist still talks with the vendor engineer to obtain pricing and technical specifications. The reply is stored in {DOCS} against the request id. A bounded pass can lift a numeric price only when the reply names a component id. The conversation is not treated as a record until the vendor writes the specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pricing arrived as mixed mail and calls, so a later estimate could not show which specification it used.
tasks.enabler_now: A request id can sit on the outbound question and on the stored reply, and a component id can mark a price row.
tasks.still_hard: Vendors answer in their own words, and the specialist still has to ask and judge whether the specification fits.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides which specification is usable and which price is not comparable.

ambition.what: Ask for a fresh price when the specification is older than the request, not only at purchase time

tasks.altitude: Chasing attachments takes less time. The conversation with the vendor stays. The specialist can refuse to file a price that has no component id.

reach.task: Read the filed price pack before an estimate
reach.learn: Which request has a specification and a price, and which is still only a conversation

evidence.claim: Getting vendor prices and specifications is a conversation plus a document. The mail can be filed. The call cannot be replaced by a form.
Vendor replies in a mid-size firm mix prose and numbers. A price without a component id is not safe to total later.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task ends when a price pack is filed or sent back. It does not place an order.
Input contract: request id, component id, hardware or software or service, site, question, needed-by date. Producer is the specialist. A reply with no request id is not filed as current.
Use the workflow form and the mailbox before custom code. The meeting and mail prior is accepted: the vendor conversation stays person work.
unknowns: Which vendors will answer against a request id.
Whether prices are confidential to a named list of staff.
research_questions: What share of vendor replies has no numeric price?
How old is the specification when someone next needs it?

already_counted.description: Vendor conversations stay with the specialist
Checking a messy reply stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Update the question list when a new service type is sourced
Vendors resend replies that lack a request id

approvals.approved_version: price pack signed for this request id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes vendors still answer only by call, so the extract rarely fires and the conversation is unchanged. The high case assumes replies contain a component id but every conversation and every acceptance stays manual. No purchase is treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still walks sites and still talks to vendors. Modification requests, backup windows and price packs become records with a decision on them.
reach: The network architect reads the signed modification decision and the filed site configuration.
The vendor engineer receives a request id instead of an open-ended mail thread.
skills_to_grow: Decide a modification from the request record rather than from a thread.
Keep a backup run inside a procedure version the specialist has signed.
Ask a vendor against a written list of hardware, software and services.
role.ambitious_version: Modification requests and vendor prices are filed against a request id, and a backup runs only from a signed procedure.
